name: Pyrithyldione
summary: Pyrithyldione (traded as Presidon, Persedon, and Benedorm among others) is a central nervous system depressant developed in 1949 as a non-barbiturate sedative-hypnotic drug. An improved method of manufacture was patented by Hoffmann-La Roche in 1959.

uses.brands: Benedorm, Didropyridine, Dihydroprylone, Persedon, Presidon, Pyridion, Pyridione, Pyrithyldion, Pyrithyldione, Tetridin, Tetridine

sideEffects.text: Agranulocytosis was reported in some patients.

summaryZh: 雙乙酮是一種戊二醯亞胺衍生物，分子式C9H13NO2，1949年發明，可作為精神藥物。

pharmacology.en: It is a central nervous system depressant with sedative and sleep-inducing effects. Its exact mechanism has not been well studied.
pharmacology.zh: 它是中樞神經抑制劑，具有鎮靜和助眠作用，確切機制尚未被充分研究。
pharmacology.zhHans: 它是中枢神经抑制剂，具有镇静和助眠作用，确切机制尚未被充分研究。

uses.en: It was used as a sedative and sleep medicine in the mid twentieth century and is rarely used today.
uses.zh: 它在二十世紀中期被用作鎮靜和安眠藥，現在已很少使用。
uses.zhHans: 它在二十世纪中期被用作镇静和安眠药，现在已很少使用。

fact.en: Pyrithyldione was introduced in 1949 as one of the first sleeping pills that was not a barbiturate, although its ring structure closely resembles theirs.
fact.zh: 雙乙酮於 1949 年問世，是最早一批非巴比妥類的安眠藥之一，不過它的環狀結構和巴比妥類非常相似。
fact.zhHans: 双乙酮于 1949 年问世，是最早一批非巴比妥类的安眠药之一，不过它的环状结构和巴比妥类非常相似。
